measurement_protocol.clock: Browser monotonic domain; explicit WASM clock calibration or local durations.

measurement_protocol.frame_gap: Separate RAF from effective revision/pose submit; measure first-demand gap and inter-submit gaps only while demand is pending.
measurement_protocol.next_down: planned -> handler entry -> admission -> first valid feedback
measurement_protocol.canonical: Up start/end, commit and exact qualified completion tracked separately.
measurement_protocol.failures: Rejected input, timeout and missing submit are failure/censored observations, not omitted latency samples.
measurement_protocol.navigation: No canonical completion receipt invented for feedback.
measurement_protocol.quantile_method: Freeze in UR0a, report per-run sample counts and p50/p95/p99/max.
measurement_protocol.real_time_vs_fixture: 30-second content timestamps are distinct from wall-time input; accelerated setup not a real-time performance run.
measurement_protocol.immediate: Next scheduled task/at most one refresh-period planned gap; no wait for settle/receipt/quiescence.

migration_registry.completion: Every MIGRATE row has public-entry reachability and a matching decision-to-leaf identity; GPU execution alone is insufficient. New callsites require registry update.

temporal_contract.next_input: Hit-dependent input requires current Scene or proven current projection; display availability alone does not authorize old-state queries.
temporal_contract.no_op: No new Operation; retire feedback against its existing committed basis.
required_cases: A-job cancelled / only B-current exact frame completes
A/B committed / Undo A / newer frame
delete / Scene recovery / current frame only
B submitted / C active / B completion
partial or old target proof rejected
temporal_contract.feedback_owner: Existing Runtime/Interaction owns gesture and handoff; Render consumes stamped immutable demands and retains derived resources; Provider reports completion. No new SDK token.
temporal_contract.stale_job_rule: Any derived job, including canonical, may stop publication when stale; retain valid immutable body/checkpoints, never retract accepted Operations or issue receipts for a newer basis.

superseding_frame_retirement.proof: Freeze eligible sealed-record set at preparation with Runtime frame/document/view/lifetime/commit/Scene/surface/metrics basis; associate existing full CanonicalWork after successful submission without enlarging set; retire only frozen set after strict qualified completion.
superseding_frame_retirement.undo_delete: Current authoritative state may supersede old feedback; do not require old mask to remain.

commit_linearization.invariant: An accepted Operation cannot be returned as not committed because History allocation or derived presentation failed.
commit_linearization.scope: Reuse existing owners; no new canonical transaction layer. No-fail finalization applies to required internal History/publication work, not allocation by external callbacks.
commit_linearization.observer_order_review: Freeze History finalization versus observer order; audit observeApplied commit-record copies, selection updates and no-DataPort SDK encoding. Observer failure cannot reverse accepted commit.

geometry_lease_contract.current_thread: owner thread; existing const geometry has mutable replay scratch and non-atomic accounting
geometry_lease_contract.future_workers: Separate immutable source/checkpoint from per-job scratch; revalidate and publish on owner
geometry_lease_contract.eviction: Remove discoverability, retain live leases until users finish
geometry_lease_contract.cross_generation: Old in-flight allocations remain charged across owner/context/view changes until actual retirement
geometry_lease_contract.callbacks: Retirement callbacks cannot retain destroyed Runtime/provider

telemetry_qualification.paired_overhead: same build/config on/off observation; acceptable overhead fixed before use

required_fork_isolation_tests: erase A leaves B pixels/hits/masks unchanged
transform A separately validates device pixels
delete/evict A preserves B live lease
document/lifetime same ObjectId rejects stale state
different allocation equal content versus same ID changed knot/config
different allocation equal content may share; knot/config change forks body; changed mask revalidates mask only; stale surface rejects device pixels, retains valid CPU body
